question: Can one small trainable value-only Transformer block (before the v5 MLP + CRF head) close most of the gap to value-span-v1 without changing v1 type/target behaviour?
out_of_scope: more than one adapter block, BiLSTM, adapters inside encoder layers, unfreezing any encoder layer, type/target fine-tuning, auxiliary token CE or any other loss term, hard BIO transition constraints, loss weighting, new/duplicated/augmented/synthetic data, label changes, hyperparameter sweep, architecture variants, a second attempt after test/probe results, numeric normalization

base_model.note: the PyTorch checkpoint gidi-finance-v1 was frozen from (models/gidi-finance-v1/manifest.json sources.checkpoint_model_safetensors); loaded as trained, never re-initialised
base_model.identical_across_runs: every value-head seed loads the same base weights; checked by sha256 of the frozen state before and after training

architecture.graph: frozen v1 encoder last_hidden_state H (after the model's shared dropout, identity in eval) -> frozen type head (mean pool of H) and frozen target BIO head (H), exactly as v1; value branch: H -> value adapter -> MLP emissions -> linear-chain CRF. The adapter returns a new tensor; H itself is never modified or replaced, and the encoder has requires_grad False so no value gradient reaches it
architecture.frozen: every encoder parameter, type head, target BIO head (requires_grad False)

value_adapter.module: one torch.nn.TransformerEncoderLayer (batch_first), value branch only; no stacking
value_adapter.dropout: 0.1 on attention weights, after the FFN activation, and on both residual branches
value_adapter.layer_norm: post-LN (norm_first False), eps 1e-5, as the RoBERTa-layout v1 encoder layers
value_adapter.attention_mask: key padding mask from the attention mask (padding keys excluded)

architecture.value_head: x2 -> Linear(768,256) -> GELU -> Dropout(0.1) -> Linear(256,3) emissions (197,635 params) -> linear-chain CRF over O / B-VALUE / I-VALUE (start [3], end [3], transitions [3,3]; 15 params; learned, no hard constraints); head arch `adapter-mlp-crf`
architecture.init: MLP and CRF exactly as v5 (private generators VALUE_HEAD_SEED_BASE (1_000_003) + seed, + 1_000_000, + 2_000_000); adapter: PyTorch default TransformerEncoderLayer init under torch.manual_seed(VALUE_HEAD_SEED_BASE + seed + 3_000_000) in a forked RNG
architecture.decoding: Viterbi over the real tokens (special tokens O), then the unchanged value span rule and best-span choice; confidence from softmax(emission) of the Viterbi tags
architecture.outputs: type_logits [batch, 8], target_logits [batch, seq, 3], value_logits = CRF emission scores [batch, seq, 3]
architecture.mode: encoder, type head, target head and the model's shared dropout in eval mode throughout; the value branch (adapter + MLP) in train mode during training, eval at evaluation

pre_training_checks: optimizer param groups contain exactly the value-branch parameters: 12 adapter tensors + 4 MLP tensors + 3 CRF tensors (19), nothing else
every v1 encoder parameter, type head and target head has requires_grad False
after the first backward pass every frozen parameter has grad None (or all zero)
frozen state sha256 equals the base checkpoint's before training, after the last epoch and in the saved checkpoint

data.validation: validation.jsonl (149), sha256 eef077c97a519dc532112683f3ab35daeaa6e55187c3c2fb01f53a0ee37f629c; logged per epoch only, never used for selection
data.test: test.jsonl (143 = 105 v1 + 38 targeted-value-01), sha256 acaca8d767828e48954e91871886ac191a45110af695af7df7573a9c0be6f91d; evaluation only
data.value_supervision: value loss only on value_status == complete; uncertain value labels masked

training.loss: value CRF negative log-likelihood only, mean over the notes of the batch with value_status == complete; uncertain notes excluded; no auxiliary token CE (none required: the CRF NLL trains emissions and transitions end to end, as in v5)
training.recipe: AdamW; lr 3e-4 for the adapter block, 1e-3 for the MLP and CRF (the v4/v5 head lr); weight decay 0.01 on weight matrices (adapter in_proj/out_proj/linear1/linear2, MLP Linear weights), 0 on biases, LayerNorms and CRF transitions; batch 8; 40 epochs; linear warmup 0.1 then linear decay (all groups); max grad norm 1.0 over the whole value branch; dropout 0.1; per-epoch shuffle seeded by seed + epoch
training.rationale: head settings identical to v5 so the change is the adapter; 3e-4 is a standard AdamW rate for a freshly initialised post-LN Transformer block with warmup (1e-3 risks post-LN instability; the v1 encoder's own fine-tuning lr is lower still); chosen before training, no sweep
training.seed_meaning: value adapter, MLP and CRF initialisation and batch order only; base weights identical

export_seed: value-head seed 1; this experiment does not export (A means stop and report)

evaluation.invariance: for every test (143, incl. the 105 frozen v1 test records) and probe (81) record, and for every value-head seed: type logits, type prediction, target logits, target BIO prediction and target span equal the base v1 checkpoint's (CPU, same inputs; logits compared with max abs diff, required 0 on CPU; predictions/spans exactly equal). Also cross-checked against the frozen v1 seed-1 predictions in experiments/value-span-v1/eval/v1-seed1-*-predictions.jsonl
evaluation.value: same metric code, sets, slices and value-quality criteria as value-span-v1 / v3 / v4 / v5 (value_gate.value_quality_criteria), Viterbi decoding: per seed, mean/std over seeds and seed 1. Reported: value exact, span precision/recall/F1, token F1, human-only exact, present/null, slices explicit_unit, bare_number, multi_number, slang, unaccented, unseen_span, long_multi_token; sets test, test-v1, test-targeted, probe, validation (monitoring)
evaluation.error_categories: every wrong value on complete labels (test, probe, per seed) classified by span position: wrong-number selection (no overlap), boundary truncation (inside gold), left overrun, right overrun into date/time, right overrun punctuation-only, other right overrun, missed (null)
evaluation.inspection: every multi-number value error on test and probe listed and inspected by hand, classified as wrong candidate selection, span truncation, date/period absorption, punctuation, or other boundary error
evaluation.tracked_cases: report only, never used for training or tuning: `cho a Nam vay 1 triệu 20/10` (gold `1 triệu`) and `Thắng vay 5 củ, hẹn t10 trả` (gold `5 củ`)
evaluation.comparison: compared with value-span-v3 (linear), v4 (MLP), v5 (MLP + CRF) and value-span-v1 (full joint fine-tune; test value exact 0.988). Error categories compared specifically against v5, with attention to v5's emission-level failures: leading number piece predicted O (`540k` -> `k`, `170` -> `0`, `612` -> `12`), B restart inside one amount (`230k` -> `2`), partial numeric token spans (`9tr5` -> `tr5`), amount vs period/date (`1 triệu 20/10`, `300 hom 5/10`)

value_slices: unseen exact surface span vs train
long/multi-token amounts (>2 v1 tokens or containing a space)

adoption_criteria.type_target: type and target predictions identical to gidi-finance-v1 (base checkpoint) on every test-v1 and probe record (test-targeted and full test also reported); any difference is an implementation failure
value_quality: test value exact (complete labels, mean over seeds) >= 0.95
test value exact on human-provenance labels >= 0.90
no value slice with n >= 5 on test below 0.80 exact

verdict.A: invariance passes and all value-quality criteria pass: stop and report success; no export and no playground change in this experiment
verdict.B: invariance passes, value quality fails: stop; no second adapter block, BiLSTM, encoder-layer adapters, partial unfreezing, new augmentation or loss weighting
verdict.C: invariance fails: implementation bug; fix only the bug and rerun the same frozen protocol

known_limitations: most value labels are rule-provenance accepted by stratum audit (0 errors in sampled strata); value metrics on them measure agreement with audited rule labels, so the human-only slice is reported separately
slices are small on test (xi 2, chai 3, lit 1, ty 0, bare 6); slice results are directional
test has 0 complete no_amount labels; null-value accuracy is measured on validation (2) and is not an adoption gate
2 trieu ruoi form is absent from all splits
the frozen v1 validation is in train, as in v1; only the 39 targeted-value-01 validation rows are held out
the adapter adds ~3.94M trainable parameters (4.14M value branch total); with 895 training notes and last-epoch selection overfitting is possible and is reported, not tuned
hypothesis: The frozen v1 encoder carries value information, but token-wise readouts (linear v3 0.765, MLP v4 0.863, MLP+CRF v5 0.902 test exact) cannot fix emission-level errors (leading number piece strongly O, B restart inside one amount, amount vs period/date). A value-specific contextual block may re-contextualise tokens for the value task only.
runtime_schema: unchanged if ever exported: type, type_confidence, target, target_span, target_confidence, value_text, value_span, value_confidence, truncated, model_version gidi-finance-v2; no numeric VND normalization; this experiment does not export
